title: 第9章 一个初级星系第10章 购买书籍
content_zh:
片刻的兴奋过后，林云迅速平复自己的心情波动，聚精会神地继续吸收着神晶能量。
一颗神晶能量，仅仅耗时几分钟，便被吸收殆尽。
在初次尝试之后，林云现在心中有了底。
按照这种修炼增长速度，林云提升到二级神境，大约需要3000颗左右。
如今林云手中所拥有的神晶，足以让林云直接提升到二级神境！
不过林云并没有这么做。
自己当下，还需赶路前往奥启星系，这需要依靠神晶作为动力。
加之路途如此遥远，所需的神晶数量不少，要是此刻便用神晶修炼，依靠自身速度，那将寸步难行。
所以林云打算，先抵达奥启星系之后再作打算。
……
祖地。
初始之地。
林云的分身，已经回到初始之地。
虽然分身只是元至尊境，但体内已然成功融入天道之心，所以林云对初始之地的掌控，以及对整个祖地和下面所有世界的掌控，依旧未曾改变。
云裳此刻依旧待在大殿外的凉亭中，着林云归来。
她身着一袭淡青色的长裙，裙袂飘飘，面容绝美，肌肤胜雪，双眸灵动如水，犹如仙子下凡。
“林云，刚刚究竟有什么事啊，走得那么急！”
云裳见林云回来，她连忙快步迎上前来，脸上满是关切之色。
“没什么大事儿，林毅要来了吗？”
林云带着微笑，轻轻捋了捋云裳的秀发，那温柔的动作，仿佛在呵护着世间最珍贵的宝物。

对于自己今日的经历，以及自己只是分身归来，本体已经前往宇宙海中探索的事，林云并不打算急着告知任何人，包括身边亲友。
林云怕告诉他们，只会让他们徒增担心。
对外林云更不可能说，免得引起不必要的动荡。
若林云本体在宇宙海探索有所发现，甚至能够帮忙送回来一些资源，到那时，再告诉他们不迟。
……
林云驾驶着宇宙飞舟，在浩渺无垠的宇宙海中一路前行，历经两年多的漫长行驶，林云终于邂逅了第一个星系。
这是与祖地距离最近的星系。
然而，它却是一个环境极为恶劣、了无生机的所在。
林云离开祖地后，这是他见到的首个星系，心中难免充满好奇与期待。
于是，林云特地降低了飞舟的速度，以便能够更仔细地观察这个星系。
从外部眺望，整个星系仿佛被一层，厚厚的冰霜所覆盖，璀璨的星光，透过冰霜折射出迷离的光彩，远远望去，既震撼人心又美不胜收。
那冰冷的光芒仿佛诉说着这个星系的孤独与寂静，让林云不禁感叹宇宙的神秘与浩瀚。
content_en:
After a moment of excitement, Lin Yun quickly calmed down his mood swings and continued to absorb the energy of the divine crystal with concentration.
The energy of a divine crystal was absorbed in just a few minutes.
After the first attempt, Lin Yun now has confidence.
According to this growth rate of cultivation, it would take about 3,000 pills for Lin Yun to upgrade to the second-level divine realm.
The divine crystals that Lin Yun now possesses are enough to directly elevate Lin Yun to the second level of divine realm!
But Lin Yun didn't do that.
At the moment, I still need to rush to the Aoqi Galaxy, which requires the power of the divine crystal.
In addition, the road is so far away and requires a lot of divine crystals. If you use the divine crystals to practice now and rely on your own speed, it will be difficult to make it.
Therefore, Lin Yun planned to arrive at the Aoqi Galaxy first before making any plans.
…
Ancestral land.
The initial place.
Lin Yun's clone has returned to the original place.
Although the clone is only in the Yuan Supreme Realm, the body has successfully integrated into the Heart of Heaven, so Lin Yun's control over the original land, as well as the entire ancestral land and all the worlds below, has remained unchanged.
Yun Shang was still staying in the pavilion outside the main hall, waiting for Lin Yun to return.
She was wearing a light cyan long dress with fluttering skirts. She had a beautiful face, her skin was as good as snow, and her eyes were as smart as water, like a fairy descending to earth.
"Lin Yun, what happened just now? You left in such a hurry!"
When Yun Shang saw Lin Yun coming back, she hurried forward to greet him with a look of concern on her face.
"It's no big deal, is Ji Yi coming?"
Lin Yun smiled and gently stroked Yunshang's hair. His gentle movements seemed to be protecting the most precious treasure in the world.
Lin Yun did not intend to rush to tell anyone, including his relatives and friends, about his experience today and the fact that he had just returned as a clone and that his true body had gone to explore the cosmic sea.
Lin Yun was afraid that telling them would only make them more worried.
It is even less possible for Lin Yun to say anything externally, so as not to cause unnecessary turmoil.
If Lin Yun himself discovers anything while exploring the cosmic sea, he can even help send back some resources. At that time, it will not be too late to tell them.
…
Lin Yun drove the spaceship and traveled all the way in the vast sea of space. After more than two years of long journey, Lin Yun finally encountered the first galaxy.
This is the closest galaxy to the ancestral homeland.
However, it is a place with extremely harsh environment and lifeless environment.
After Lin Yun left his ancestral land, this was the first galaxy he saw, and his heart was inevitably full of curiosity and expectation.
Therefore, Lin Yun specially slowed down the speed of the spacecraft so that he could observe the galaxy more carefully.
Viewed from the outside, the entire galaxy seems to be covered by a thick layer of frost. The bright starlight reflects the blurred brilliance through the frost. Looking from a distance, it is both shocking and beautiful.
The cold light seemed to tell the loneliness and silence of this galaxy, making Lin Yun couldn't help but sigh at the mystery and vastness of the universe.
